correctness.rationale: Verified 2-by-2 trace and determinant formulas and the full cyclic eigenvalue list. The exact rational resolvent identity has a single sign change and zero unweighted integral; the standard fractional-power representation gives a strict negative weighted eigenvalue for every \(0<r<1\). The positive companion eigenvalues follow from positivity and strict AM--GM; the all-dimensional Pauli-corner scaling adds only a constant rank-one Gram term; binomial expansion gives the \(q^4\) coefficient. Exact rational script and direct 2-by-2 calculations corroborate critical algebra, not replace proof.

The decisive uniform sign is proved here by a resolvent crossing argument.

value.rationale: The result resolves the natural stability question left by three-point positivity and its pure four-point obstruction: positivity does not recover even infinitesimally near the maximally mixed state under full-rank common-spectrum constraints. An exact negative eigenvalue and sharp nonzero quartic coefficient show the order and size of first failure for all \(d\ge2\) and \(0<r<1\). It is a motivated structural boundary with no arbitrary external cutoff.
